# Okpala Chimaobi Samuel (Kremz)

> Okpala Chimaobi Samuel, known as Kremz, Elon Kremz or ElonKremz, is a Nigerian software developer and technology entrepreneur. He is the founder and CEO of Codex Tech Foundation (now becoming Sephry Tech) and the creator of the Zerøbyte product ecosystem. He is from Anambra State, based in Nigeria, and studies Computer Science at Caritas University, Enugu State.

## Key facts
- Sephry Tech is the organization brand. Zerøbyte is a separate, independent product ecosystem.
- Zerøbyte products: ID, Cloud, Social, Business, Copilot and Vault (.zbb Zerøbyte Backup Bundle backups).
- Zerøbyte Business is a business management SaaS for Nigerian SMEs, launching late November or early December 2026.
- Contact: okpalachimaobi55@gmail.com
